name: Vector Toolkit
description: Geoprocessing tools for sampling and tessellation: hexagon and square grids over a layer's extent, and random points inside polygons.
author: opengeos

tools.name: Hexagon Grid
tools.summary: Covers a layer's extent with hexagons of a given size.

params.name: size
params.label: Cell width (km)
params.help: The distance across a hexagon's flat sides, measured at the extent's middle latitude.

params.name: touching
params.label: Only cells with features
params.help: Keep only cells that contain a vertex of an input feature.

tools.name: Square Grid
tools.summary: Covers a layer's extent with square cells (a fishnet).

tools.name: Random Points In Polygons
tools.summary: Scatters random points inside each polygon.

params.name: seed
params.label: Random seed
params.help: The same seed gives the same points.

az.Geoprocessing tools for sampling and tes: Nümunə götürmə və mozaika üçün geoemal alətləri: layın hüdudu üzərində altıbucaqlı və kvadrat torlar, həmçinin poliqonların daxilində təsadüfi nöqtələr.
az.Covers a layer's extent with hexagons of: Layın hüdudunu verilmiş ölçülü altıbucaqlılarla örtür.
az.Scatters random points inside each polyg: Hər poliqonun daxilində təsadüfi nöqtələr səpələyir.

de.Geoprocessing tools for sampling and tes: Geoverarbeitungswerkzeuge für Stichproben und Tessellation: Sechseck- und Quadratraster über die Ausdehnung eines Layers und Zufallspunkte innerhalb von Polygonen.
de.Covers a layer's extent with hexagons of: Überdeckt die Ausdehnung eines Layers mit Sechsecken einer bestimmten Größe.
de.Covers a layer's extent with square cell: Überdeckt die Ausdehnung eines Layers mit quadratischen Zellen (ein Gitternetz).

es.Geoprocessing tools for sampling and tes: Herramientas de geoprocesamiento para muestreo y teselación: cuadrículas hexagonales y cuadradas sobre la extensión de una capa, y puntos aleatorios dentro de polígonos.
es.Covers a layer's extent with hexagons of: Cubre la extensión de una capa con hexágonos de un tamaño dado.
es.Covers a layer's extent with square cell: Cubre la extensión de una capa con celdas cuadradas (una malla).
es.Scatters random points inside each polyg: Distribuye puntos aleatorios dentro de cada polígono.

fr.Geoprocessing tools for sampling and tes: Des outils de géotraitement pour l'échantillonnage et le pavage : grilles hexagonales et carrées sur l'emprise d'une couche, et points aléatoires dans des polygones.
fr.Covers a layer's extent with hexagons of: Couvre l'emprise d'une couche d'hexagones d'une taille donnée.
fr.Only cells with features: Uniquement les cellules avec des entités
fr.Covers a layer's extent with square cell: Couvre l'emprise d'une couche de cellules carrées (un maillage).
fr.Scatters random points inside each polyg: Disperse des points aléatoires à l'intérieur de chaque polygone.

id.Geoprocessing tools for sampling and tes: Alat geoprosesing untuk sampling dan teselasi: grid heksagon dan persegi di atas cakupan layer, serta titik acak di dalam poligon.
id.Covers a layer's extent with hexagons of: Menutupi cakupan layer dengan heksagon berukuran tertentu.
id.Covers a layer's extent with square cell: Menutupi cakupan layer dengan sel persegi (fishnet).
id.Scatters random points inside each polyg: Menyebarkan titik acak di dalam setiap poligon.

it.Geoprocessing tools for sampling and tes: Strumenti di geoprocessing per campionamento e tassellazione: griglie esagonali e quadrate sull'estensione di un layer e punti casuali all'interno di poligoni.
it.Covers a layer's extent with hexagons of: Copre l'estensione di un layer con esagoni di una dimensione data.
it.Covers a layer's extent with square cell: Copre l'estensione di un layer con celle quadrate (un fishnet).
it.Scatters random points inside each polyg: Distribuisce punti casuali all'interno di ogni poligono.

ja.Vector Toolkit: ベクター ツールキット
ja.Geoprocessing tools for sampling and tes: サンプリングとテッセレーションのためのジオプロセシング ツール: レイヤーの範囲を覆う六角形と正方形のグリッド、ポリゴン内のランダム ポイント。
ja.Covers a layer's extent with hexagons of: 指定したサイズの六角形でレイヤーの範囲を覆います。
ja.Extent from layer: 範囲の取得元レイヤー
ja.Only cells with features: フィーチャを含むセルのみ
ja.Covers a layer's extent with square cell: 正方形のセル (フィッシュネット) でレイヤーの範囲を覆います。
ja.Random Points In Polygons: ポリゴン内のランダム ポイント
ja.Scatters random points inside each polyg: 各ポリゴン内にランダムなポイントを散布します。
ja.Points per polygon: ポリゴンあたりのポイント数

ko.Geoprocessing tools for sampling and tes: 샘플링 및 테셀레이션용 지오프로세싱 도구: 레이어 범위를 덮는 육각형 및 정사각형 격자, 폴리곤 내 임의 포인트.
ko.Covers a layer's extent with hexagons of: 지정한 크기의 육각형으로 레이어 범위를 덮습니다.
ko.Scatters random points inside each polyg: 각 폴리곤 안에 임의 포인트를 흩뿌립니다.

nl.Geoprocessing tools for sampling and tes: Geoverwerkingsgereedschappen voor steekproeven en tessellatie: zeshoekige en vierkante rasters over het bereik van een laag, en willekeurige punten binnen polygonen.
nl.Covers a layer's extent with hexagons of: Bedekt het bereik van een laag met zeshoeken van een gegeven grootte.
nl.Covers a layer's extent with square cell: Bedekt het bereik van een laag met vierkante cellen (een rooster).
nl.Scatters random points inside each polyg: Verspreidt willekeurige punten binnen elke polygoon.

pt.Geoprocessing tools for sampling and tes: Ferramentas de geoprocessamento para amostragem e tesselação: grades hexagonais e quadradas sobre a extensão de uma camada e pontos aleatórios dentro de polígonos.
pt.Covers a layer's extent with hexagons of: Cobre a extensão de uma camada com hexágonos de um tamanho especificado.
pt.Covers a layer's extent with square cell: Cobre a extensão de uma camada com células quadradas (uma malha).
pt.Scatters random points inside each polyg: Espalha pontos aleatórios dentro de cada polígono.

ru.Geoprocessing tools for sampling and tes: Инструменты геообработки для выборки и тесселяции: шестиугольные и квадратные сетки по экстенту слоя и случайные точки внутри полигонов.
ru.Covers a layer's extent with hexagons of: Покрывает экстент слоя шестиугольниками заданного размера.
ru.Scatters random points inside each polyg: Размещает случайные точки внутри каждого полигона.

tr.Geoprocessing tools for sampling and tes: Örnekleme ve mozaikleme için coğrafi işleme araçları: bir katmanın kapsamı üzerinde altıgen ve kare ızgaralar ile poligonların içinde rastgele noktalar.
tr.Covers a layer's extent with hexagons of: Bir katmanın kapsamını belirli boyutta altıgenlerle kaplar.
tr.Covers a layer's extent with square cell: Bir katmanın kapsamını kare hücrelerle (bir ızgara) kaplar.
tr.Scatters random points inside each polyg: Her poligonun içine rastgele noktalar dağıtır.

vi.Geoprocessing tools for sampling and tes: Các công cụ xử lý không gian để lấy mẫu và lát phủ: lưới lục giác và lưới vuông phủ phạm vi của một lớp, và các điểm ngẫu nhiên bên trong vùng.
vi.Covers a layer's extent with hexagons of: Phủ phạm vi của một lớp bằng các hình lục giác có kích thước cho trước.
vi.Only cells with features: Chỉ các ô có đối tượng
vi.Covers a layer's extent with square cell: Phủ phạm vi của một lớp bằng các ô vuông (lưới ô vuông).
vi.Scatters random points inside each polyg: Rải các điểm ngẫu nhiên bên trong mỗi vùng.

zh-CN.Geoprocessing tools for sampling and tes: 用于采样和镶嵌的地理处理工具：覆盖图层范围的六边形和正方形格网，以及多边形内的随机点。
zh-CN.Covers a layer's extent with hexagons of: 用指定大小的六边形覆盖图层范围。
zh-CN.Covers a layer's extent with square cell: 用正方形单元覆盖图层范围（渔网）。
zh-CN.Scatters random points inside each polyg: 在每个多边形内随机分布点。
